description: This file defines the DeviceResources class responsible for managing DirectX device, swap chain, and rendering resources for a Windows application using DirectX and XAML interop. It includes initialization, resizing, device validation, and presentation logic specific to DirectX rendering pipeline.

classes.name: DeviceResources
classes.description: Manages Direct3D, Direct2D, swap chain, and related rendering resources, handling device creation, resizing, validation, and presentation.

methods.name: CreateDeviceIndependentResources
methods.description: Initializes Direct2D, DirectWrite, and WIC factories.

methods.name: CreateDeviceResources
methods.description: Creates the Direct3D device, context, and associated Direct2D device and context.

methods.name: CreateWindowSizeDependentResources
methods.description: Creates or resizes swap chain buffers, render target views, depth stencil views, and related resources based on window size.

methods.name: SetSwapChainPanel
methods.description: Associates a SwapChainPanel with the device resources and initializes rendering targets.

methods.name: SetLogicalSize
methods.description: Updates logical size and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: SetDpi
methods.description: Updates DPI and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: SetCurrentOrientation
methods.description: Updates display orientation and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: SetCompositionScale
methods.description: Updates composition scale factors and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: ValidateDevice
methods.description: Checks if the device is still valid; recreates device and resources if needed.

methods.name: HandleDeviceLost
methods.description: Recreates device and related resources after device removal.

methods.name: RegisterDeviceNotify
methods.description: Registers a callback for device lost/restored notifications.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Informs the driver that the app is suspending, allowing resource reclamation.

methods.name: Present
methods.description: Presents the swap chain content to the screen, handling device removal scenarios.
